# Juan Arcila — Senior Full-Stack Developer

> Ingeniero en Informática y Desarrollador Full-Stack Senior desde Venezuela.
> Abierto a trabajo remoto y relocalización en Europa.
> Engineer and Senior Full-Stack Developer based in Venezuela, open to remote work and relocation in Europe.

## About
Juan Arcila is a Senior Full-Stack Developer focused on React.js, Next.js, NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. He builds scalable web applications, APIs, and digital products for remote, hybrid, and relocation opportunities in Europe and Estonia.

## Services and specialties
- Full-Stack development
- Front-end architecture with React and Next.js
- Back-end APIs with NestJS and Node.js
- PostgreSQL and database-driven applications
- Product modernization and web application maintenance
- Multi-tenant SaaS platforms and offline-first POS systems
- Mobile apps (Android / Capacitor) with native barcode scanning
- Remote collaboration and agile delivery (SCRUM / XP)

## Stack principal
- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: NestJS, Node.js, Express, REST APIs
- Base de datos: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma ORM
- Móvil: Capacitor, Android, Java, ML Kit
- Metodologías: SCRUM, XP (Extreme Programming)

## Availability
- Remoto: sí (inmediato)
- Híbrido/Presencial: sí
- Relocalización: Europa (requiere patrocinio de visa)
- Open to work in Europe and Estonia, with immediate availability for remote or hybrid opportunities.
